title: Course Correction
summary: Make new columns with mutate(), sort with arrange(), and take the top rows with slice_head().
hints: One `mutate()` can make several columns: `mutate(days = hours_mission / 24, age_at_mission = year_of_mission - year_of_birth)`.
`arrange(desc(days))` puts the longest first; then `select(name, year_of_mission, days)` and `slice_head(n = 5)`.
